findings.title: Log contains a certificate-verification failure
findings.detail: A known certificate error string appears in the supplied text; its origin and current status are not verified.
findings.next_step: Ask the responsible owner to check the approved proxy and trusted CA chain. Do not bypass verification based on this report.

findings.title: Log contains a proxy-denial signal
findings.detail: The supplied text includes a possible proxy denial. Combined logs can contain unrelated events.
findings.next_step: Check the intended destination and the existing network policy through the authorized owner; no policy change is implied.

findings.title: Registry and network-denial signals occur together
findings.detail: A package-registry reference and a denial signal appear in supplied text. Their causal relationship and current reachability are not verified.
findings.next_step: Check whether documented setup or a nested tool step needs registry access; confirm the existing policy with its owner.

limits: This is static triage of supplied files, not a connection or security test.
No server, command, package, or MCP tool is executed; no network is used.
Rules can miss problems and can match unrelated messages in combined logs.
No matched rule means not verified, not readiness or safety.
Local runtime checks, when requested, inspect this host's PATH only; configured paths and environments are not tested.
Reports omit raw names, arguments, environment values, endpoints, paths, and log excerpts. The original inputs remain local.
exit_zero_means: Analysis completed; it is not a readiness, safety, or connection result.
